description: Integrate OpenLIT as an optional OpenTelemetry instrumentation bridge. This work converts upstream selection into evidence-backed Project Pipeline integration rather than treating the catalog as passive research.
exclusions: No live paid-provider execution, remote repository mutation, or unreviewed source vendoring is claimed.
objective: Integrate OpenLIT as an optional OpenTelemetry instrumentation bridge
observability_impact: Upstream usage and adapter state become explicit evidence-bearing system state; optional instrumentation is non-authoritative.
rationale: Project Pipeline must materially reuse reviewed upstream implementations where they improve commodity capabilities while preserving deterministic internal authority, provenance, and rollback boundaries.
rollback_recovery_consideration: Remove or disable the optional adapter/dependency, restore the prior internal fallback, and preserve provenance records describing the retired upstream integration.
scope: Integrate OpenLIT as an optional OpenTelemetry instrumentation bridge
security_impact: Upstream execution remains bounded by allowlists, fixed adapters, reviewed licenses, explicit approvals, secret handling, and Project Pipeline policy authority.
